title: More foreigners seek health screenings in South Korea
caption:
Foreign arrivals seeking routine medical evaluations in South Korea jumped seventeen percent last year. Travelers from North America and across Asia cite bundled testing and rapid results as the primary draw.

Source: Koreaherald - More foreigners seek health screenings in South Korea
